title: Lost: One Camera, Red Band

pre.en: Where was Chen's camera in the end?
pre.zh: 小陈的相机最后在哪儿？
options: On a bench in the Great Hall

intro: 一段对话：小陈在约克的国家铁路博物馆丢了相机，Tom 帮他一句一句改给博物馆的正式邮件——先说来意，再讲经过、描述东西，最后礼貌地提请求。读的时候留意 have sth done：had my bag checked、had my photo taken，是「让别人替我做」，不是自己做。结尾有个反转。

sentences.en: Tom, can you help me with this email?
sentences.zh: Tom，能帮我看看这封邮件吗？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's to the railway museum, about my camera.
sentences.zh: 是写给铁路博物馆的，问我相机的事。

sentences.en: Sure. How does it start?
sentences.zh: 行啊。开头怎么写的？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: "Dear Sir or Madam."
sentences.zh: 「尊敬的先生/女士：」
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: "I'm writing to ask about a camera I lost at the museum on Thursday afternoon."
sentences.zh: 「来信是想询问一台相机，我周四下午把它落在了贵馆。」

sentences.en: Good. Are you sure you lost it there?
sentences.zh: 不错。你确定是在那儿丢的？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Well, I had my bag checked at the entrance at about two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，两点左右我在入口让人查过包。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: As far as I know, the camera was still in it then.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，那时相机还在包里。

sentences.en: And after that?
sentences.zh: 后来呢？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I had a go at the train driving game.
sentences.zh: 我玩了一会儿开火车的游戏。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Then I had my photo taken next to Mallard.
sentences.zh: 然后请人给我在「野鸭号」旁边拍了张照。

sentences.en: Did you keep an eye on your bag, like I told you?
sentences.zh: 你看好包了吗？我可跟你说过。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: To be honest, I paid more attention to the trains than to my bag.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我光顾着看火车了，没怎么留意包。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I think the camera got left on a bench in the Great Hall.
sentences.zh: 我觉得相机是落在大厅的长椅上了。

sentences.en: Of course it did.
sentences.zh: 果然。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: OK, describe the camera.
sentences.zh: 好吧，描述一下相机。

sentences.en: It's an old black Fujifilm with a red band, and it isn't worth much.
sentences.zh: 是一台黑色的老富士相机，背带是红色的，不值什么钱。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: But it means the world to me.
sentences.zh: 可它对我来说太重要了。

sentences.en: It was my grandfather's, and he taught me to use it step by step.
sentences.zh: 那是我爷爷的，是他一步一步教我用的。

sentences.en: He gave it to me when I moved to the UK, to help me settle in.
sentences.zh: 我来英国的时候，他把相机送给了我，好让我早点适应这边的生活。

sentences.en: And it's got all my photos from this week on it.
sentences.zh: 里面还有我这周拍的所有照片。

sentences.en: Right. Now ask them to look out for it, but politely.
sentences.zh: 好。现在请他们帮忙留意一下，不过要客气点。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: "I'd be grateful if your staff could check the Great Hall."
sentences.zh: 「如贵馆工作人员能帮忙查看一下大厅，我将不胜感激。」
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: "I'm staying in York until Sunday, and I'd love to get it back before then."
sentences.zh: 「我在约克待到周日，很希望在那之前能拿回相机。」

sentences.en: Perfect. You've got your message across.
sentences.zh: 完美，意思说得很清楚。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: And if they find it after we've gone?
sentences.zh: 那要是我们走了以后才找到呢？

sentences.en: "If it's found later, I'd like to have it posted to my flat in London."
sentences.zh: 「如果之后才找到，我想请你们寄到我在伦敦的住处。」
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: "I'll happily pay for the postage."
sentences.zh: 「邮费我很乐意承担。」

sentences.en: Morning, boys!
sentences.zh: 早啊，小伙子们！
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: Look, I've had the battery replaced at the shop on Gillygate.
sentences.zh: 瞧，我在吉利盖特街那家店给它换了块电池。

sentences.en: Is that... my camera?
sentences.zh: 那是……我的相机？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I borrowed it yesterday, love.
sentences.zh: 我昨天借去用啦。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: You were busy with the trains.
sentences.zh: 你那会儿忙着看火车呢。

sentences.en: I've taken 212 photos of drainpipes on listed buildings.
sentences.zh: 我拍了 212 张受保护老建筑上的排水管。

sentences.en: Delete the email, Chen.
sentences.zh: 小陈，把邮件删了吧。
sentences.speaker: Tom

cards.zh: 来信是想……（邮件开头说明目的）
cards.note: used at the start of an email or letter to say why you are writing
cards.tip: 后面接动词原形：I'm writing to ask / to apologise / to confirm；比 I want to … 正式、礼貌。
cards.example: I'm writing to complain about my last order.

cards.note: 出口是 exit；at the main entrance 在正门。
used to say that you think something is true, but you are not completely sure
cards.tip: 说的是自己的了解有限；不说 as far as I knew it，也不说 as long as I know。
cards.example: As far as I know, the meeting is still at three.

cards.note: to try to do something, often for the first time
cards.tip: 英式口语；后面接名词或 doing：have a go at cooking。
cards.example: I've never cooked Chinese food, but I'll have a go.

cards.note: mallard 本义是绿头野鸭；作火车名时首字母大写，不加 the。
to watch something or someone carefully so that nothing bad happens
used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
to watch, listen to or think about something carefully
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing；pay 的过去式是 paid。
cards.example: Please pay attention to the safety notes.

cards.note: 公园、车站、博物馆里供人坐的长凳。
band 常见的意思是「乐队」，这里指一圈带子；橡皮筋叫 rubber band。

cards.zh: 对某人来说无比重要；是某人的宝贝
cards.note: to be extremely important to someone, usually because of feelings or memories
cards.tip: 比第 12 课的 mean a lot to sb 语气更重；主语是东西或人，to 后面接人：She means the world to me。
cards.example: This old watch isn't expensive, but it means the world to my dad.

cards.note: doing one thing at a time, in a fixed order

cards.zh: （在新地方、新工作）安顿下来；适应
cards.note: to start to feel happy and relaxed in a new home, job or school
cards.tip: 常说 settle in at work / in a new city；问别人可以说 Have you settled in?
cards.example: It took me a few weeks to settle in at my new job.

cards.note: to watch carefully so that you will notice something or someone
cards.tip: 和第 41 课的 keep an eye on 比：look out for 是「留意着找」，keep an eye on 是「看着别出事」；单说 Look out! 是「小心！」。
cards.example: Look out for a blue door on the left.

cards.zh: 如果……我将不胜感激（礼貌请求）
cards.note: a polite way to ask someone to do something, often used in formal emails
cards.tip: if 后面常用 you could …；比 Please … 客气得多，正式邮件常用。
cards.example: I'd be grateful if you could reply by Friday.

cards.note: to have something again after you lost it or gave it to someone
cards.tip: 东西放在 get 和 back 中间：get it back；借出去的东西要回来也用它。
cards.example: Did you ever get your money back?

cards.zh: 把意思讲清楚；让人听明白
cards.note: to make people understand what you want to tell them
post 是邮寄（英式），postage 是邮寄的费用；美式多说 shipping。
换电池是 replace the battery，充电是 charge the battery；电量低说 The battery is low。
英国老房子外墙上竖着的铁管，把屋顶的雨水排下来。
